chains.description: List of chains, separated by comma, to be used for clustering and similarity search

input_pdb_dir.description: Path to directory with PDB files to be used as input

dssp_csv.description: Path to CSV file with DSSP annotations for the input PDB files. Required if similarity_method is 'secondary_structure'

interface_residues_csv.description: Path to CSV file with interface residues for the input PDB files. Required if similarity_method is 'interface_residues'

cyclic.description: Is the structure cyclic or not?

similarity_method.description: Method to calculate similarity between structures. Supported values: 'sequence', 'rmsd', 'secondary_structure'

linkage_method.description: Linkage method to be used for hierarchical clustering. Supported values: 'single', 'complete', 'average', 'ward'

threshold.description: Threshold to apply when forming flat clusters. The meaning of the threshold depends on the chosen criterion.

criterion.description: Criterion to use for forming flat clusters. Supported values: 'distance', 'inconsistent', 'maxclust'
